Compose a three-axis ordination biplot

Source: R/recipes-ordination.R
stat_biplot_3d.Rd

Site scores become points; species or variable scores become solid-headed quiver arrows from the origin. Optional group regions use the existing ellipsoid or convex-hull statistic. For prcomp, the coordinates are x and rotation. For vegan fits, extraction and scaling use vegan::scores(). A named list returned by that function can also be supplied directly. Each arrow-tip label touches its tip on the side the arrow points to on the page, as vegan::ordiArrowTextXY() places biplot labels, and like all text it is drawn over the scene.

Usage

stat_biplot_3d(
  model,
  choices = 1:3,
  groups = NULL,
  region = c("none", "ellipsoid", "hull"),
  loading_scale = 1,
  point_size = 1.5,
  label_loadings = TRUE,
  label_size = 4,
  arrow_colour = "#5C6166",
  level = 0.95,
  scores_args = list()
)

Arguments

model

A prcomp fit, a vegan ordination fit, or a list with sites and optional species score matrices.

choices

Three ordination axes.

groups

Named group vector, keyed by site-score row names, or a data frame with id and group columns. Its row order is arbitrary.

region

"none", "ellipsoid" or "hull".

loading_scale

Explicit multiplier of variable/species scores.

point_size

Site marker size in millimetres.

label_loadings

Whether to label arrow tips.

label_size

Arrow-tip label size, in ggplot2 text size units (mm).

arrow_colour

Colour of the arrow shafts and their unshaded cone heads.

level

Ellipsoid coverage level.

scores_args

Additional arguments to vegan's scores method.

Value

A list of layers to add to a ggplot with coord_3d().

Examples

fit <- stats::prcomp(iris[1:4], scale. = TRUE)
groups <- stats::setNames(iris$Species, rownames(iris))
ggplot2::ggplot() + stat_biplot_3d(fit, groups = groups,
  region = "ellipsoid", loading_scale = 2) + coord_3d()
